shortDescription: Enable and Disable Simultaneous MultiThreading Mode

options.name: bos_boot
options.description: This runs the bosboot after the respective action get executed.It is freeform command can executed with any parameter.

options.name: chtype
options.description: C(boot or now) This take either boot or now value.

options.name: smt_extra
options.description: C("recommended or suspend") This values is mutually exclusive with smt_value and smt_state.

options.name: smt_limit
options.description: This values set the limit for the multithreading.

options.name: smt_state
options.description: This enable or disable  the SMT in the lpar.

options.name: smt_value
options.description: This value takes appropriate SMT value
